mission.title: alertmanager: No documentation on how to setup a custom email template
mission.description: No documentation on how to setup a custom email template. Requested by 8+ users.

steps.title: Check current alertmanager deployment
steps.description:
Verify your alertmanager version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/name=alertmanager
helm list -n alertmanager 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working alertmanager installation.

steps.title: Review alertmanager configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant alertmanager configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/name=alertmanager
kubectl get configmap -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=alertmanager
```
**What did you do?**
Trying to add a custom email template. This is not an usage related question, since the docs for adding a custom email template are missing.

steps.title: Apply the fix for No documentation on how to setup a custom email template
steps.description:
#### Summary

Add a complete example showing how to define an external HTML email template, load it with the top-level `templates` glob, and reference it from an email receiver. The example stays intentionally small while covering the configuration gap described in #1602.

#### Pull Request Checklist

- Please list all open issue(s) discussed with maintainers related to this change
    - Fixes #1602
- Is this a new Receiver integration?

- Is this a bugfix?

- Is this a new feature?

- Does

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/name=alertmanager
kubectl get events -n alertmanager --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "No documentation on how to setup a custom email template" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
#### Summary

Add a complete example showing how to define an external HTML email template, load it with the top-level `templates` glob, and reference it from an email receiver. The example stays intentionally small while covering the configuration gap described in #1602.

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with alertmanager installed or the issue environment reproducible.
